text: Volksbank BRAWO eG is a cooperative bank based in Wolfsburg. The legal notice of the BRAWO GROUP website names it as the site’s provider.

source.name: Volksbank BRAWO eG / BRAWO GROUP: Impressum
source.quote: Volksbank BRAWO eG Am Mühlengraben 1 38440 Wolfsburg
source.note: The page is the legal notice (Impressum) of brawogroup.de. It names Volksbank BRAWO eG as the provider ('Anbieter') and gives its legal form as 'Eingetragene Genossenschaft' (registered cooperative).
